selectAllTitle: Select or deselect every available printer
addConfiguredTitle: Add a printer configured in OrcaSlicer
connectionTypeTitle: Connection type. Active integrations provide live status, controls and upload. Unavailable entries remain planned targets.
serialTitle: The serial is discovered automatically. Enter one only to pin a specific printer. MQTT port 8883 is used.
selfSignedTitle: Enable only for a printer served over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate. Plain HTTP LAN printers do not need this.
historyCoverage: Local observed print history. It includes prints started by Print Farm and jobs seen while this dashboard was open; work performed while OrcaSlicer was offline may be missing.
historyEmpty: No observed prints for this printer yet.
noPrinters: No printers found. Configure a printer host in OrcaSlicer, or add one above.
integrationUnavailable: Printer integration is not available yet
sendToPrinterTitle: Send to this printer and start printing
file3mfWarning: .3mf starts only on Bambu printers — the others expect G-code.
unmatchedQueued: {count} queued file(s) match no printer on the dashboard
outboxWriteFailed: Could not retain the G-code file
supportPlanned: {type} support is planned but not available yet.
notReachableNotStarted: {printer}: printer is not reachable — not started.
fileReadFailed: Send failed: could not read the file.
errorUnknownSerial: uploaded, but the printer serial is still unknown — start it from the printer
errorNeedsBambuCredentials: printer IP, access code and serial are required
